entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by the AMF to the UE to indicate authentication failure and instruct the UE to abort all activities.

entities.name: Extended protocol discriminator
entities.description: Identifies the protocol type for the message.

entities.name: Security header type
entities.description: Specifies the security header format applied to the message.

entities.name: Spare half octet
entities.description: Reserved bits for alignment or future use.

entities.name: Authentication reject message identity
entities.description: Identifies the message as AUTHENTICATION REJECT.

entities.name: EAP message
entities.description: Optional EAP message for extended authentication procedures.

entities.name: Authentication failure
entities.description: Condition where authentication procedure fails, triggering the AUTHENTICATION REJECT message.

entities.name: UE shall abort all activities
entities.description: Behavior enforced on the UE upon receiving AUTHENTICATION REJECT, requiring termination of all ongoing activities.

relations.description: AUTHENTICATION REJECT message includes the Extended protocol discriminator IE.
AUTHENTICATION REJECT message includes the Security header type IE.
AUTHENTICATION REJECT message includes the Spare half octet IE.
AUTHENTICATION REJECT message includes the Authentication reject message identity IE.
AUTHENTICATION REJECT message optionally includes the EAP message IE.
Authentication failure condition triggers the AMF to send AUTHENTICATION REJECT message.
Receipt of AUTHENTICATION REJECT establishes that the UE shall abort all activities.
